mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN (SELECT st.warehouse_id, st.material_id, SUM(st.qty) AS qty FROM wms_stock st WHERE st.warehouse_id IN (SELECT warehouse_id FROM ecom_owh_warehouse) GROUP BY st.warehouse_id, st.material_id) e ON e.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id AND e.material_id = s.material_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.to_warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, di.material_id, SUM(di.qty) AS qty FROM wms_stock_doc d JOIN wms_stock_doc_item di ON di.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.kind = 'TRANSFER' AND d.status = 'TRANSIT' AND d.to_warehouse_id IN (SELECT warehouse_id FROM ecom_owh_warehouse) GROUP BY d.to_warehouse_id, di.material_id) t ON t.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id AND t.material_id = s.material_id

s.id, s.mapping_id, s.warehouse_id, s.sku, s.material_id, s.available_qty, s.transit_qty, s.locked_qty, s.sync_time, s.create_time, s.update_time, a.name AS account_name, m.owh_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, mt.code AS material_code, mt.name AS material_name, mt.spec AS material_spec, COALESCE(e.qty, 0) AS erp_qty, COALESCE(t.qty, 0) AS erp_transit_qty, s.available_qty + s.locked_qty - COALESCE(e.qty, 0) AS diff_qty

FROM ecom_owh_stock s JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse m ON m.id = s.mapping_id JOIN ecom_owh_account a ON a.id = m.account_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_material mt ON mt.id = s.material_id
mapper.select: SELECT mt.code AS "code", mt.id AS "id" FROM wms_material mt WHERE mt.code IN #{c}

SELECT st.material_id AS "materialId", mt.code AS "code", SUM(st.qty) AS "qty" FROM wms_stock st JOIN wms_material mt ON mt.id = st.material_id WHERE st.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} GROUP BY st.material_id, mt.code HAVING SUM(st.qty) > 0 ORDER BY mt.code
SELECT mt.id AS "id", mt.code AS "code", mt.name AS "name" FROM wms_material mt WHERE mt.id IN #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ecom_owh_stock (mapping_id, warehouse_id, sku, material_id, available_qty, transit_qty, locked_qty, sync_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{r.mappingId}, #{r.warehouseId}, #{r.sku}, #{r.materialId}, #{r.availableQty}, #{r.transitQty}, #{r.lockedQty}, #{r.syncTime}, NOW(), NOW())
